summary.text: Alabas Farhat is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House District 3 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works in government relations.

paragraphs.text: Alabas Farhat earned a bachelor's degree in public health from the University of Michigan at Dearborn in 2021 and a master's degree in public policy analysis from the University of Michigan in 2023.

His career experience includes working in government relations with Wayne County, Michigan, as a field organizer with the Michigan Democratic Party, and as a field director for former Michigan State Representative Abdullah Hammoud.
Farhat assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In 2023-2024 he served on the Economic and Small Business Development, Health Policy and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and was majority vice chair of the Tax Policy Committee; in 2025-2026 he is minority vice chair of the House Appropriations Committee.
